---
name: Change proposal
about: Suggest an improvement before substantial implementation
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: enhancement
---

### Problem

Who is affected, and what can they not do today? Use synthetic examples only.

### Smallest useful change

Describe the behavior you want and the source or user journey it would affect.

### Evidence and limits

What have you checked? Note relevant alternatives, tradeoffs or data boundaries.
Do not include customer material, credentials or private infrastructure details.
